hero.subline: I build software for Android — trading, community, architecture, automation — and the performance work that makes it feel fast. Every project here is taken apart.

about.title: About
paragraphs: Software engineer, Android by trade, product by habit. At ████████ I work across the whole surface rather than one corner of it: trading, community, architecture, automation and research — the features people use every day, and the systems that keep them fast and shippable.

I measure before I believe. The parts I like best are the ones nobody demos — the slow list, the flaky test, the migration with a deadline — because they are where measurement separates a guess from a decision.
This site is that method applied to itself: every project taken apart layer by layer, with the numbers that came out of the measurements.
about.skillsNote: Kotlin · Compose · Coroutines · Room · Clean architecture · Android profiling · Automation · Firebase · CI/CD
